name: com.getmcpads/apple-ads
title: Apple Ads
description: Apple Ads MCP server: 9 read tools, 11 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: clientId shown in Apple Ads under Account Settings > API.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADS_TEAM_ID
environmentVariables.description: teamId shown in Apple Ads under Account Settings > API.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: keyId shown in Apple Ads under Account Settings > API.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADS_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EC P-256 private key in PEM text. Set this or APPLE_ADS_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH. Keep it secret.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADS_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the private key PEM file, instead of APPLE_ADS_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADS_AD_ACCOUNT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed ad account IDs. Required even for reads.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true enables write tools. Defaults to false.
